name: Carmen Crespo Díaz - Après le considérant AN - Am 3
title: REPORT on the future of agriculture and the post-2027 common agricultural policy
part_text: ANa. whereas non-EU countries such as Morocco, Türkiye and South Africa have emerged as major exporters of agricultural products to the Union; whereas the agricultural sectors of those countries are characterised by lower production costs and are subject to environmental, social and labour standards that differ significantly from those applicable in the Union, thereby resulting in conditions of unfair competition for EU farmers;
